# API Contracts

> Source of truth for all API routes.

---

## Conventions

- Success: `{ data: T }`
- Error: `{ error: { code: string, message: string } }`
- Status codes: 200/201/400/401/403/404/422/500

## Routes

<!-- Generated by /write-specs -->

### POST /api/[resource]

**Auth:** authenticated

**Request:**
```typescript
z.object({ field: z.string().min(1) })
```

**Success — 201:**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "uuid", "field": "value" } }
```

**Errors:** 400, 401, 422
